policy: Upstream repositories are pinned by full commit SHA and never copied. The only upstream logic in this repository is in spark_membrane/engines/ and spark_membrane/frames.py: small, labelled reference re-implementations that are tested against outputs of the pinned upstream code (tests/fixtures/upstream_reference.json) and, in CI, live against checkouts of these exact commits.

repositories.name: oes32-residual
repositories.role: Normative OES-32 residual (ADR-001): R = max_i |y_i - x_i|, fail iff R > tolerance.
repositories.note: Pinned at the ADR-001 normative commit, not HEAD. src/, residual_definition.md and failure_criterion.md are byte-identical between b77b612 and HEAD 7277e0f; later commits are docs, CI, licence and citation metadata.

repositories.name: oes32_engine
repositories.role: Profile A sidecar: SAFE = A and C0 and C1 and Cfold (coherence, EVEN/ODD symmetry, FOLD8 continuity); LATCH = not SAFE.

repositories.name: oes32-membrane-shield
repositories.role: Capability gate (Ed25519, v2). spark_membrane/shield.py mirrors its role table only; signatures are not re-implemented.

repositories.name: oes-telemetry-bench
repositories.role: Native 32-channel JSONL frame contract; max-abs / EWMA / CUSUM baseline definitions; synthetic held-out result (max-abs 6/7 at 11.54/h vs OES32 6/7 at 23.08/h).

repositories.name: oes-resilience
repositories.role: Weighted block score 0.45*max|x| + 0.35*RMS + 0.20*mean|x| (OES32Detector); v0.5.0 SMAP/MSL result: success criterion not met.
repositories.note: Tag v0.5.0 = 85dc5e6f63696e0cd7d2d2a276a596b71f74bb37; HEAD adds docs only. The detector code is unchanged since v0.4.0 = 15692152f1851bde617efd3a61fc09485dbe8ed7 (the commit oes-telemetry-bench pins).

repositories.name: measurement-trail
repositories.role: Hash-chained JSONL record format used for the run trail; CI verifies the committed demo trail with the upstream verifier.

repositories.name: evidence-passport
repositories.role: Run-manifest schema v1; CI validates docs/passport/manifest.json with the upstream validator.

repositories.name: quantum-claims-passport
repositories.role: Claim-type classification with fail-closed fencing; the model for spark_membrane/claims.py.

repositories.name: multi-quantum-oes
repositories.role: Cited for its preregistered SYNTHETIC stress evaluation (no demonstrated advantage over max-abs). Its toy simulations never enter the audit.

repositories.name: oes32-hls
repositories.role: Cited for status only: FPGA synthesis UNRUN. Its squared-difference, >= rule is a different Profile A sidecar and is not used here.

repositories.name: qldpc_decoder_cpp
repositories.role: Cited for status only: BP kernel is a scaffold; HLS synthesis and hardware runs UNRUN.

repositories.name: signal-loom
repositories.role: Art skin only (performance-art prototype, MIT). Linked from the page; nothing from it enters the audit.
